title: Tatoe Tsugai ja Nakute mo
titleNative: たとえ番じゃなくても
synonyms: Even if it's not my turn
Even If You’re Not My Mate
synopsis: In a world where humans are Betas and beastmen are divided into Alphas and Omegas, beastmen live among the human majority by taking on human forms. Akihiko is a snow leopard beastman who seems to have everything. He is an Alpha, the heir to a powerful and wealthy family, and handsome features in his human form. Yet the people around him only care about his status. Tired of this shallow way of life, Akihiko transfers from an elite private school to a public one while keeping his beast form, hoping to find someone who will love him for who he is. Without a personal chauffeur for once, Akihiko arrives at school and is greeted by Haruyoshi aka Haru, a boy with beautiful tan skin and sharp teeth. With Haru, Akihiko experiences an ordinary crêpe for the first time, visits an arcade, and makes his very first friend. As their friendship grows, so do Akihiko's feelings for Haru...

title: Scavengers Another Sky
titleNative: スカバンジャーズ アナザースカイ
synopsis: In a hidden research facility known as the “Bus Stop,” a fearless crew of treasure hunters — Scavengers — embarks on dangerous missions into the Black Parade, a mysterious parallel world filled with untold riches. Their mission: to gather valuable loot and earn a million dollars for their freedom. But there’s a deadly twist. The Black Parade is home to a vengeful entity determined to protect its treasures at any cost. With weapons drawn, the Scavengers face high-octane action, paranormal threats, and mind-bending mysteries in this thrilling sci-fi adventure. As they explore an eerie world full of bizarre creatures and unexplainable forces, they must rely on their wits, weapons, and teamwork to survive. But the deeper they go, the more they realize that the true cost of their mission might be more than they ever expected. (Source: Titan Manga) Note: The one-shot got published on July 20th, 2022 on the magazine Young Champion Retsu, and due to the popularity of this work, it was decided to serialize it. The one-shot was numbered as the first chapter of the manga, and the first chapter of the serialization got numbered as the second chapter of the series.

title: Ruri no Houseki
synopsis: Mineral collecting is like a modern-day treasure hunt! Ruri, a high school girl who loves jewelry and accessories, gets into the world of mineral collecting, venturing into mountains, rivers, and caves. The first volume features numerous minerals, including quartz, garnet, pyrite, gold sand, and fluorite. The manga is full of fascinating scenes focusing on specialized tools such as a panning dish, hammer, and topographical maps. An authentic scientific adventure based on the author's solid knowledge of mineralogy! (Source: Harta, translated)

synopsis: In a desperate bid to save the "Hashidate University High-Dimensional Engineering Laboratory" from closure, the genius—and stunningly beautiful—Professor Enri Nagisawa races across campus in search of new recruits. She soon joins forces with three eccentric girls—an "Android from Outer Space," a "Mecha-Obsessed Disciplinary Committee Member," and a "Masochistic Heiress"—and together, they transcend the bounds of reality to do whatever they please! synopsis: Hatori is an ordinary teacher leading an ordinary life at an ordinary high school. One day, he notices that one of his students, Spica Tsumugi, is being bullied. On his way home from school, he ends up alone with Tsumugi in the rain. Hatori calls out to her, “Sensei will help you!" But Tsumugi gently takes his hand and says with a smile, “Hatori-sensei is such a liar." Teacher and student… two people who should not get too close. The seductive girl that will turn Hatori's ordinary life upside down… (Source: Kodansha, translated)

synopsis: Owari Machida was a professional fisherman who made a name for himself in the media, but his former glory proved short-lived, and he struggles everyday to make ends meet. One day, while out boat fishing, he gets swept away by the waves and fell into the sea, losing consciousness as he downs because of a malfunction of his life jacket. When Owari awakens, the scenery has completely changed—he finds himself in an Isekai... In this world where the culture of fishing has declined, Owari wanders around enjoying fishing with the fishing gear that transmigrated with him, while interacting with the locals... But this "fake" marriage could unearth something very real! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes the extra chapters "Anaerobic Love" and " Fake Married Life".
